resources.string: You can create up to %1$d profiles. You can still edit or share existing profiles. Share any profiles you want to keep before removing them.
You\'ve changed this profile from how it ships with Nocturne.
Its steps, timings, limits and name go back to how they ship. The nights it\'s set for stay. Nothing is saved until you tap Save.

Changed built-in profiles go back to how they ship, keeping the nights they\'re set for, and any you deleted come back. Your own profiles stay as they are. A snapshot is saved first, so you can undo this from Settings, Backups.
Built-in profiles restored. A snapshot was saved first.

Boost, the Remote\'s quick settings, snooze, extend and the notification buttons go back to their defaults. Your profiles, alarms, theme and BedJet stay as they are. A snapshot is saved first, so you can undo this from Settings, Backups.
Controls reset to defaults. A snapshot was saved first.
This is a test build. Installing a release means uninstalling it first, which deletes your profiles and settings. Export a backup file now, then restore it in the release.
If you exported a backup file before uninstalling, restore it to get your profiles and settings back.
